method: Long official privacy-policy pages, extracted with scripts/prepare-real-policies-round12.py; one reviewer froze document-category labels and audit questions before inference; source text remains in gitignored .cache/real_policies_round12.
annotationNotes: Contacts requires an affirmative device address-book access or upload. Google recipient suggestions from existing contacts do not alone establish device address-book access; WhatsApp expressly allows contact upload.
Advertising requires use of personal information to choose, personalize, or target ads. WhatsApp's ads in Status/Channels and related cookies do not by themselves affirm targeting in this notice.

AI training requires affirmative training with users' content or personal data. Google describes public web material used to train models, and WhatsApp describes a Meta AI feature; neither passage alone affirms training on this policy's users' private content.
Retention is positive when information is held until account deletion or as long as needed, even though the same policy gives fixed deadlines for other categories.

auditQuestions.en: Does Google affirm collecting location information?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Google declara que recoge información de ubicación?

auditQuestions.en: Does Google affirm uploading the device address book in this policy?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Google declara que carga la agenda del dispositivo en esta política?

auditQuestions.en: Does Google's public-web AI-model passage affirm training on private account content?
auditQuestions.es: ¿El pasaje de datos web públicos de Google confirma entrenamiento con contenido privado de la cuenta?

auditQuestions.en: Does Google keep any categories for open-ended business or legal purposes?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Google conserva alguna categoría por fines comerciales o legales sin plazo fijo?

auditQuestions.en: Can WhatsApp upload contacts from the device address book?
auditQuestions.es: ¿WhatsApp puede cargar contactos de la agenda del dispositivo?

auditQuestions.en: Does this WhatsApp notice affirm personal-data-based ad targeting?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Este aviso de WhatsApp confirma anuncios dirigidos con datos personales?

auditQuestions.en: Does using Meta AI through WhatsApp itself establish training on chat content?
auditQuestions.es: ¿Usar Meta AI en WhatsApp demuestra por sí solo entrenamiento con chats?

auditQuestions.en: Does WhatsApp retain some account data while the account remains active?
auditQuestions.es: ¿WhatsApp conserva algunos datos mientras la cuenta esté activa?
